protocol.effect_scale_note: 0.1 mm is a declared illustrative decision scale, not a sourced hardware requirement.
protocol.scope: Hypothetical internal restrictions only; keep entrance and exit, target, beam and strength bounds unchanged. Nominal clearance optimization, frozen before new test. Original test is retrospective validation only.

baseline.objective: maximize full minimum five-sigma nominal clearance with epigraph constraints
baseline.peak_constraint: horizontal beta <=60 m on 16 subdivisions, checked at64

horizontal_restriction.objective: maximize full minimum five-sigma nominal clearance with epigraph constraints
horizontal_restriction.peak_constraint: horizontal beta <=60 m on 16 subdivisions, checked at64

vertical_restriction.objective: maximize full minimum five-sigma nominal clearance with epigraph constraints
vertical_restriction.peak_constraint: horizontal beta <=60 m on 16 subdivisions, checked at64

selection_policy: nominal clearance only; no test used for selection. Finite two-start search, no global optimality.
